policy.purpose: Build an offline, progressive project-management curriculum from authoritative and redistributable sources without substituting secondary summaries for official material.
selection_rules: Prefer official standards, methodology owners, audit institutions, and public-sector delivery bodies over popularity alone.
Treat processed Markdown as the agent teaching layer and originals as the evidence layer.
Pin GitHub sources to reviewed revisions and URL sources to explicit version labels plus reviewed SHA-256 hashes after the first verified sync.
Use broad guides only when they teach durable management mechanisms such as governance, schedule, cost, risk, flow, value, acceptance, or control.
Do not vendor proprietary PMI, ISO, PRINCE2, certification-course, or commercial-book text without explicit redistribution rights.
